discription: A percussive FM plucked string sound, with a bright attack and decaying timbre. Useful for bass lines or melodic plucks.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, atk=0.005, rel=0.5, modIndexInitial=10, modRatio=1.414; var sig; var envAmp = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(atk, 0.1, 0.7, rel, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var envMod = EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(atk, rel*0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate); sig = SinOsc.ar(freq, SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio) * (freq * envMod * modIndexInitial)); sig = sig * amp * envAmp; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
